description_zh: SUV在Oak Street接近停止标志路口处，因前方Waymo AV正停车等待行人和交通，未能及时停车，发生追尾。测试SUV(ego)能否在停止标志控制下检测前方静止车辆并刹停。

source_snippets: While in autonomous mode, the Waymo AV came to a stop at a stop sign on Oak Street. While the ADV was stopped, waiting for a pedestrian to cross and for traffic on Stanyan Street to clear, an SUV approached the Waymo AV from behind and made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: VEH 1: A. STOPPED, VEH 2: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT
TYPE OF COLLISION: VEH 2: C. REAR END
evidence.reason: SUV移动并追尾静止的AV，ego选为SUV以测试其能否及时停车，场景可用stopped_ahead + stop_sign表达。
